chunks: And Safwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Ṭalḥah al-Nahdī, from Sawrah ibn Kulayb, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man leaves his house intending the mosque or intending some need, and another man meets him or confronts him, then strikes him and takes his garment.

He said: “What do the people where you are say about it?” He said: I said: “They say: this is open violent aggression, and the muḥārib is only in villages of the polytheists.” So he said: “Which of the two is greater in sanctity: the abode of Islam or the abode of shirk?” He said: So I said: “The abode of Islam.” He said:
“These are among the people meant by this verse: ‘The only recompense of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger’”
to the end of the verse.

key_terms.الْآيَةِ: the Qur'anic verse invoked as the legal basis
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, mentioned as the intended destination of the victim
key_terms.الْمُحَارِبُ: one who wages war through violent banditry or armed aggression
key_terms.دَارُ الشِّرْكِ: the abode or territory of polytheism, contrasted with Dār al-Islām
key_terms.دَارُ الْإِسْلَامِ: the abode or territory of Islam, whose sanctity is emphasized
key_terms.دَغَارَةٌ: open violent aggression or brazen assault
key_terms.يُحَارِبُونَ: they wage war, referring to hostile aggression addressed by the verse

ai.seo_question: Does the Qur'anic ruling on muḥārabah apply to violent robbery committed inside the land of Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith applies the Qur'anic ruling of muḥārabah to one who violently assaults and robs a person within Dār al-Islām. The Imam عليه السلام rejects limiting this ruling to polytheist lands and instead grounds it in the sanctity and security of the Islamic community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5125 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Talhah Al-Nahdi from Sawrah ibn Kulayb who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who leaves his house intending to go to the mosque or fulfill a need and is met or confronted by another man who strikes him and takes his garment.

Abu Abdullah (as) asked: "What do the people in your region say about this?"
I replied: "They say this is open aggression (dagharah muʿlanah), and that a highway robber (muharib) only exists in the lands of polytheists."
Imam (as) then asked: "Which is more sacred: the land of Islam or the land of polytheism?"
I replied: "The land of Islam."
Imam (as) said:

"These people fall under the ruling of this verse:
'The punishment of those who wage war against Allah (swt) and His Messenger'"
(until the end of the verse). (Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:33)
